# The analysis outputs (data/analyses) and run metadata (data/meta) record the hash of the code commit that
# produced them. This public copy rewrote commit author addresses and co-author lines, which changes every hash;
# file contents, dates and commit titles are unchanged. Each line gives: recorded hash, then the hash of the same
